digest.component_or_area: Documentation and prose standards repository audit
propositions: Repository-wide audit of documentation, comments, and embedded prose must apply comprehensive formal-voice standards covering prohibited punctuation, diction, paragraph structure, authenticity padding, and adjective necessity.

Evidence-based remediation proposals require canonical source identification, factual verification against implementation and tests, audience classification by shard ownership, and cross-shard challenge filtering for accuracy and completeness.

Documentation governance framework must establish ownership policy, lifecycle rules, citation conventions, generated artifact provenance, and canonical-source tracking across durable records, internal documents, external guidance, and shipped help.

Maintained prose validation and enforcement requires both source-aware automated checking and manual review to protect structural elements while detecting prohibited forms and reporting meaning-sensitive candidates.

Exploration and filtering separation with three challenge passes must identify false guidance, missing discovery, policy defects, factual errors, placement mismatches, and duplication before any project file changes.

Generated sources including CLI references, MCP descriptions, configuration references, ADR indexes, and synchronized templates must record canonical sources, ownership, derivation paths, and drift detection mechanisms.
